# Credited real-photo test fixture

`hatchling_nps.jpg` is an unmodified copy of [*Green sea turtle hatchling faces the Gulf surf*](https://npgallery.nps.gov/AssetDetail/00b48eaf-155d-451f-67ce-e8a3834917f0), credited to the **U.S. National Park Service**. The NPS gallery asset marks it **Public Domain** with full granting rights. It is used only for the real-checkpoint image integration test and can also be uploaded manually to the Studio.

The larger external-media collection retains the same file and its source metadata at `data/external_test/`.
